articles.title: Kaspersky identifies malware framework targeting crypto investors
articles.snippet: Cybersecurity company Kaspersky said a newly identified malware framework is targeting cryptocurrency investors through social engineering tactics and trojanized GitHub apps.

articles.title: The British Virgin Islands are a top crypto hub no one ever talks about: Here’s why
articles.snippet: Kraken, Bitstamp, 1inch and Bitfinex have all set up shop in the British Virgin Islands — but you might find it tricky to book an on-site meeting with one of their executives.

articles.title: Trump teleprompter operator made $100K betting on Kalshi markets tied to speeches: ABC
articles.snippet: According to ABC News, federal regulators are investigating whether the longtime White House staffer used nonpublic information to profit from event contracts tied to President Donald Trump’s speeches.

articles.title: Leaks Reveal Suno Fed Thousands of Hours of Deezer, YouTube and Pond5 Data Into Its AI
articles.snippet: Source code leaked reveals how substantial portions of Suno’s training library were assembled.

articles.title: Team Behind Ethereum's Institutional Privacy Push Spins Out For-Profit Firm EthSystems
articles.snippet: The startup's backers, including Bitmine and Joe Lubin, are betting institutions need a privacy layer before running money on a public chain.
